drivingQuestion: How is ר׳ אלעזר בן ירמיה's measure of the time of seclusion to be understood?
outcomeNote: Rav Ashi's dilemma is left unresolved (תיקו)

segments.he: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן יִרְמְיָה אוֹמֵר: כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּקְשׁוֹר גַּרְדִּי נִימָא. בָּעֵי רַב אָשֵׁי: דִּמְרַחַק, אוֹ דִּמְקָרַב? תֵּיקוּ.
segments.en: The Gemara discusses an opinion cited in the first baraita. «Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeya says:» This is «equivalent» to the time needed for «a weaver to tie a string. Rav Ashi asks:» Is this speaking of «where» the ends of the string to be tied «are far» apart from each other, «or» is it speaking of «where» they «are near» to each other? The Gemara states: The question «shall stand» unresolved.
